I replied to Marcus in his #north-team thread: the main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Quarrendon Freight Lines' Director of Yard Operations.

She raised the duplicate arrivals on door 6 (morning shift) in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025, and Dana said she'd look into it separately. The cause was one trailer showing up as two 06:30 rows: the driver checked in at the kiosk and dispatch then added him by hand. Marcus is in #north-team, so he could already see all of this.

I couldn't find a more recent owner for that issue in anything Marcus can see, and told him so. Her job title is a contact detail, so it's fine to share with the North team even though I found it in the account's contracts. I didn't share any money terms.
